title: Cloud 3D - GOES-16 Tropical Cyclones Finetuning Dataset
description: Cloud3DTACO is a large-scale AI-ready dataset pairing 2D multispectral geostationary imagery from GOES-16, Himawari-8/9, and MSG/SEVIRI with co-located 3D vertical cloud profiles from the CloudSat radar, comprising roughly 500,000 samples organized for self-supervised pretraining and supervised finetuning. This specific subset contains 121 GOES-16 finetuning samples focused on tropical cyclone structures (eyewalls and rainbands) derived from IBTrACS best-track records. Each sample consists of a geostationary imagery patch paired with an aligned CloudSat vertical profile label, both stored as Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs.

## README.md
# A Global, AI-Ready Dataset for 3D Cloud Reconstruction **Cesar Aybar**¹ · **Shirin Ermis**² · **Lilli Freischem**² · **Stella Girtsou**³⁴ · **Kyriaki-Margarita Bintsi**⁵ **Emiliano Diaz Salas-Porras**¹ · **Michael Eisinger**⁶ · **William Jones**² · **Anna Jungbluth**⁶ · **Benoit Tremblay**⁷ ¹Universitat de València  ·  ²University of Oxford  ·  ³National Observatory of Athens  ·  ⁴National Technical University of Athens  ·  ⁵Harvard Medical School & Massachusetts General Hospital  ·  ⁶European Space Agency  ·  ⁷Environment and Climate Change Canada
--- ## About Cloud3DTACO pairs 2D multispectral geostationary imagery from **GOES-16**, **Himawari-8/9**, and **MSG/SEVIRI** with co-located 3D vertical cloud profiles from the **CloudSat** radar. The collection contains roughly 500,000 samples across 10 datasets, organized into a self-supervised **pretraining** stage (no labels) and a supervised **finetuning** stage (CloudSat profiles as ground truth). Each stage covers the three operational geostationary regions and includes a tropical-cyclone variant. The dataset is published as TACO v3 and follows FAIR principles. ## Datasets | Subset | Pretraining (no labels) | Finetuning (CloudSat labels) | |---|---|---| | GOES-16 — Americas | [50,000 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/pretraining/goes) | [31,046 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/finetune/goes) | | Himawari-8/9 — Asia & Oceania | [50,000 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/pretraining/himawari) | [57,373 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/finetune/himawari) | | MSG/SEVIRI — Europe & Africa | [50,000 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/pretraining/msg) | [181,653 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/finetune/msg) | | GOES — Tropical cyclones | [41,423 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/pretraining/goes-cyclone) | [121 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/finetune/goes-cyclone) | | Himawari — Tropical cyclones | [38,711 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/pretraining/himawari-cyclone) | [361 samples](https://source.coop/taco/3dclouds/finetune/himawari-cyclone) | | **Total** | **230,134** | **270,554** | ## Storage - **Pretraining** — each sample is a single multi-band Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF at `DATA/{idx}.tif`. - **Finetuning** — each sample is a folder with two COGs: `DATA/{idx}/geo_patch.tif` (geostationary imagery) and `DATA/{idx}/cloudsat_aligned.tif` (vertical cloud profile labels). ## Notebooks - [**Demo 1 — Dataset Exploration & Visualization**](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1ecZF5p_A_BkBi_G0LtizqeRgmNWFn2sq) - [**Demo 2 — Self-Supervised Pretraining**](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1z_xK7-Irp8Ohba_l3dtIGavRjQpxT3Zc) - [**Demo 3 — Supervised Finetuning**](https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1P0CLVEGo-puhG2cHkpjc4BUooVm7nx4t) - **Demo 4 — Pretraining + Finetuning** *(coming soon)* ## Acknowledgements This work was enabled by the Frontier Development Lab (FDL) Earth Systems Lab, a public-private partnership between the European Space Agency (ESA), Trillium Technologies, and the University of Oxford. We thank the teams behind the GOES, Himawari, and Meteosat satellites for their invaluable data. This research was supported by computational resources from Google Cloud.
